description: Public safety is one of the first responsibilities of government. Tennessee families deserve to be safe in their homes, on their streets, and in their communities. That means holding violent criminals accountable, supporting law enforcement, protecting victims, and making sure repeat offenders are not quickly returned to the streets.This session, the General Assembly passed several important public safety measures.
